description: Both endpoints of each equation belong to the finite subterm support of its ground equality problem.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.equations_supported.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Problem L) :
  P.equations ⊆
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.support P).product
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.support P)
